source_document: 2026-27 NBA Regular Season Schedule By Date
source_document_header: 2026-27 NBA REGULAR SEASON SCHEDULE AS OF AUGUST 13, 2026 | SUBJECT TO CHANGE
extraction_tool: fetch_page (PDF text extraction, chunks 1 and 2 of 13)

window.rule: requested maximum horizon of 3 calendar days from the observation time; every game on 11/16, 11/17 and 11/18 is inside the window, so the window ends with the last 11/18 tip rather than mid-day

extraction_notes: The PDF prints the column header "LOCAL | ET". tip_et_col1 is the local tip time at the home venue and tip_et_col2 is Eastern time, both as printed.

Rows 215-269 print two team cells and no 'at' token between them. The away/home reading is taken from (a) the printed order, (b) the games-page URL slug, and (c) the official injury report's AWAY@HOME code where that report prints the same game and date. No value is inferred.

Three rows disagree between the August schedule PDF and the NBA.com games page on tip time (rows 256, 266, 267). Both values are published as printed; neither is corrected, because the schedule PDF says SUBJECT TO CHANGE and no official document states which value supersedes the other.
The games-page count for 11/18 is 12 games (NBA.com games calendar, Sat-21 grid cell '18 / 12 GAMES'); 12 rows 258-269 were read and published, matching that count.
No model output, line, price or pick is stored here.
